This turn closed out the negative-result side and corrected the evidence base.

**Crash recovery — the `#[ignore]`d tests now run and pass.** `omnipaxos/tests/recovery_test.rs` is the only place crash recovery (PersistentStorage + node kill/restart, kompact + TCP) is exercised, and all four tests are `#[ignore]`d, so the captured runs never touch it. Run explicitly in the isolated executor: **4 passed, 0 failed** ([notes/core_recovery_ignored.log](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-16_23-10-28-omnipaxos-baseline/work/notes/core_recovery_ignored.log)). The recovery path works; what was missing is any automatic coverage of it.

**New core probes (in-process, deterministic, no sockets)** — [audit_leader_change_adoption_test.rs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-16_23-10-28-omnipaxos-baseline/work/omnipaxos/tests/audit_leader_change_adoption_test.rs), all passing:

- *Stale new leader adopts a more up-to-date log* (two shapes the captured `sync_test`/`reconnect_test` never drive, since their leaders always have the longest log): node 3 is cut off while nodes 1–2 decide three entries, then forced to lead with a higher ballot — once knowing nothing (hard partition), once in the same accepted round with an empty log (every `AcceptDecide` to it dropped, so the other `log_sync` branch runs). Both times all three nodes end with `decided_idx = 3` and the identical decided log `[1,2,3]`: nothing lost, nothing duplicated.
- *Partition + leader-churn safety soak*: 4 seeds × 1000 rounds, partitions redrawn every round, proposals issued on whichever node reports itself leader (so followers take `ProposalForward`), a random node forced to bump its ballot every 29 rounds. Asserted every round: agreement with all peers on every decided entry of the common prefix, no entry value decided twice anywhere, `decided_idx <= accepted_idx`. All four seeds pass, and the final states show genuine divergence (e.g. p1 at 143/162 decided/accepted vs p2/p3 at 158), so the soak really did keep nodes apart and force resynchronisation.

**Evidence-base corrections.** Summing the saved `test result:` lines showed my earlier eyeball totals were off: the captured core suite is 34 passed / 4 ignored (37 with the three audit probes), the `unicache` combination is 41 / 4 ignored, and the runtime suite is 28 (24 integration + 4 unit). Recorded in the table, and flagged as a caveat that I had quoted estimates before. Two captured runtime tests also assert essentially nothing — `append_notify_shutdown_error_when_actor_gone` accepts any outcome, and `dropping_all_handles_shuts_actor_down` never asserts the shutdown it names.
